_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Zhang, Z.[Zhigang], Zhang, A.[Aidi], Wu, K.[Kaifang], Zhang, Q.[Qinqin], Hu, A.[Angran], Li, W.[Wenxiu], Separation of ethyl acetate and 2-propanol azeotropic mixture using ionic liquids as entrainers, Fluid Phase Equilib. 429 (2016) 331-338
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0063. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.12 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
